thread:
Aisha: Heads-up — Northstar tenant cutover is scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. During the preflight image smoke I found the bastion VM image missing the customer KMS client cert mount. That will block vault-unseal and any HSM-backed key ops. Can infra owners confirm who owns the image pipeline?
Ben: @Aisha thanks for the flag. I thought the image bake included the cert-agent sidecar. Where did you look? path was /etc/kms/client.pem?
Aisha: yep, checked the VM snapshot at /var/lib/images/2026-03-17-bastion. No /etc/kms, and the init logs show: 
```
Mar 17 02:12:03 init: kms client: cert not found
Mar 17 02:12:03 init: skipping unseal
```
Carmen: tagging—I own the bake pipeline. We had a change last week to move cert mounting to the host-level hook. Maybe customer bootstrap step didn't run. I'll check the bake logs.
Eduardo: @Carmen if the host hook is opt-in per-tenant, Northstar might still be on the old profile. Can we confirm the tenant profile used in their activation?
Aisha: tenant activation shows profile "onprem-standard-v2" in the activation payload. That should include host-hook. Strange.
Carmen: pulling bake logs now. quick grep shows the hook failed with a 403 when trying to hit the registry to fetch the signed cert package.
Ben: 403 from registry — that smells like a registry auth token issue on the build runner. Which runner did the bake use? ephemeral-runner-07?
Carmen: yes ephemeral-runner-07. Runner logs show: 
```
2026-03-16T22:45:10 runner: GET /registry/northstar/certs -> 403
2026-03-16T22:45:11 runner: token refresh failed: 401
```
Eduardo: Runner token refresh is handled by the infra-auth service. I can look at the auth service logs, but need the runner id and the request id. Carmen, can you paste the full log line?
Carmen: full line: `req=6f8a2c auth=infra-auth runner=ephemeral-runner-07 token_refresh=failed status=401`.
Aisha: This is getting into ownership intersection: bake pipeline (Carmen) -> infra-auth (Eduardo) -> registry perms (Ben). Can we map owners and decide next actions?
Ben: I'll verify registry ACLs for northstar/certs. If the runner token is expired or missing role binding the artifact fetch will 403. My ask: Carmen, can you re-run a one-off bake with `--no-cache` and capture the auth exchange headers? Use `curl -v` to the registry endpoint during the hook.
Carmen: will do. ETA 30m. Re-running locally with debug now.
SRE-bot: Incident note created: "northstar-bake-cert-fetch-1767012345" assigned to @Carmen, @Eduardo, @Ben. Pager not triggered.
Eduardo: I'll tail infra-auth logs for req=6f8a2c and see why token refresh returned 401. Might be the short-lived service account key rotation. If so, we'll want a short mitigation: create a temporary PAT for runner and add to the bake hook config for tomorrow's cutover.
Aisha: For cutover plan: if we can't get certs into the image in time, fallback is: run a post-boot agent that pulls certs from internal registry over the private peering once the customer VPN is up. But that requires network egress to registry from their VPC — need network owner's signoff.
Ben: Network owners: @Eduardo can you confirm VPC peering egress rules allow registry access before the app plane is up? If not we'll need NAT + route to allow bootstrap.
Eduardo: Current default denies egress until the onprem bootstrap policy flips the egress flag. We can flip it early for the canary IP range. Two options: (1) flip on the tenant profile boolean (fast, but global for tenant) or (2) create a temporary route for the canary bastion IPs (more surgical). Preference: route for canary.
Aisha: Route for canary sounds good. Who can create it? Carmen or NetOps?
Carmen: I can request it but NetOps must apply. I'll open a NetOps ticket with the canary IPs in 5m.
Ben: If NetOps can't do it fast enough, fallback plan B is: we provide a signed cert bundle in a signed URL that we copy into the image as a last-minute patch. Security ok with signed URL?
Eduardo: Signed URL is acceptable for emergency, but we should rotate and invalidate after cutover. Also ensure the URL is scoped to the canary IPs.
Aisha: Ok action items: 
- Carmen: finish re-bake + capture auth headers (ETA 30m)
- Ben: validate registry ACLs + prepare temp signed-url workflow (ETA 45m)
- Eduardo: check infra-auth req=6f8a2c and confirm route plan + give NetOps ticket details (ETA 20m)
- NetOps: apply canary route if approved (TBD)
- Aisha: I'll update Northstar PM and push the cutover canary window to 09:30 PT if we need extra time.
DevOpsBot: Reminder: please add the deployment tag "northstar-cutover-2026-03-18" to the release and mark the canary as `manual`.
Carmen: quick update — the re-bake returned the same 401, but when I replayed the auth handshake I see the runner didn't include the `X-Runner-Role` header. Looks like a missing env injection in the ephemeral runner image.
Ben: that env comes from infra-secrets-service during runner bootstrap. Carmen, can you capture the runner bootstrap logs? If the env isn't injected we have a bootstrap bug.
Carmen: captured and attached to the ticket (link in NetOps ticket).
Eduardo: infra-auth confirms they issued tokens fine; the runner wasn't presenting the role header so the token had no scope. That narrows to runner bootstrap path. I'll get a one-off hotfix to inject `X-Runner-Role=builder` for ephemeral-runner-07.
Aisha: Good. If hotfix goes in and registry ACLs are ok we should be green for the canary. If not, use signed URL + route. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll standby for Carmen's re-bake result and run a quick ACL smoke when ready.
Carmen: re-bake succeeded after hotfix. certs pulled. Pushing new image to staging and kicking a canary verify.
SRE-bot: Canary verify started for northstar-bastion image. Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/1767012345
Eduardo: NetOps applied route for the canary. Verified registry reachable from canary VPC.
Aisha: thanks all. I'll hold off on delaying cutover for now. If canary passes we'll proceed with 09:00 PT. If not, I'll delay to 09:30 and re-run this thread.
Ben: canary passed. moving to green. :rocket:
Aisha: closing the loop — Northstar PM notified, cutover proceeding 09:00 PT. Thanks team!
